get_package.description: Read a package on Hex.pm: its description, latest and latest stable versions, licences, links, downloads (all time, last 90 days, last week and yesterday), owners, how many releases it has and which are retired, how many security advisories it has, and the lines that add it to a mix.exs, rebar.config or erlang.mk project.

mock_response.description: A blazing fast JSON parser and generator in pure Elixir.
mock_response.name: jason

get_package.name: get_package

parameters.description: The package's name on Hex.pm. Pick one of the most downloaded from the list, or type any name; a hex.pm or HexDocs address works too.
parameters.name: package

docs_url.description: Its documentation on HexDocs; empty when it has none

downloads_last_7_days.description: Downloads in the last seven days

erlang_mk_dependency.description: The line that adds it to an erlang.mk Makefile, such as dep_phoenix = hex 1.8.16

first_published_at.description: When it was first published, in ISO 8601 UTC

last_published_at.description: When it last published a release of any version, in ISO 8601 UTC

latest_stable_version.description: The newest version that is not a pre-release; empty when it has none

licenses.description: The licences it is published under, such as MIT

links.description: The links its owners give, such as GitHub

name.description: What the link is, as the package names it, such as GitHub

mix_dependency.description: The line that adds it to an Elixir project's mix.exs, such as {:phoenix, "~> 1.8"}

owners.description: The usernames of the people who can publish it; 'List a package's owners' gives their details

rebar_dependency.description: The line that adds it to an Erlang project's rebar.config, such as {phoenix, "1.8.16"}

release_count.description: How many versions it has published

repository.description: The Hex repository it is in: hexpm for public packages

retired_versions.description: Versions its owners have retired, telling people not to use them

security_advisory_count.description: How many security advisories have been published against it

source_url.description: Where its source code lives, such as its GitHub page; empty when it names none

updated_at.description: When the package last changed, in ISO 8601 UTC

description: Look up Elixir, Erlang and Gleam packages on Hex.pm, the package registry of the Erlang ecosystem. Search packages and rank them by downloads, newest or recently updated; read a package, its releases and one release's dependencies, publisher and retirement; list a package's owners and security advisories; and look up a user and the packages they own. A trigger starts a workflow when a package publishes a new release. No account or API key required.

hex_pm_new_release_trigger.description: Runs when a package publishes a new version on Hex.pm, with when and by whom it was published, the Elixir version and packages it needs, and links to it and its docs. Can skip pre-releases.

parameters.description: The package to watch, by its name on Hex.pm, such as phoenix or jason.
parameters.name: package

parameters.description: Every new release (the default), or stable releases only, skipping pre-releases such as 1.8.0-rc.0.
parameters.name: versions
